title: GTDataworks Pack Record v3
description: One released training-data row with exact row, final-row privacy, conservative split-lineage, source-artifact, provenance, authorship and rights bindings. Version 3 admits RIGHTS_ASSERTED or PASSED only when Foundry assay status is PASS. Rights evidence is not translated into PASSED.

content_sha256.description: Hash of this record's released content value, retained from v1.

released_row_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact released row bytes in released_row_format. This binds the record to what is actually delivered, including every field and delimiter covered by that format.

released_row_format.description: Versioned byte serialization/canonicalization identifier used when computing released_row_sha256.

authorship_class.description: Who authored the bytes. Rights are not uniform across a trace, so this is required. 'mixed' is never admissible: split the record first.

source.description: Upward binding to a sealed source. Provider, session and native-record locators are optional because older and non-native evidence may not expose them.

source_hash_sha256.description: Hash of the excluded source material. Provenance stays verifiable without redistributing the source.

source_session_id_sha256.description: One-way binding to the native session identity. A sellable pack must not expose the provider's raw session identifier.

native_record_ordinal.description: One-based record ordinal within native_artifact_sha256. This locator is structural and does not carry a member path or provider identifier.

captured_at.description: Terms change over time, so when a trace was captured is part of the rights fact.

source_ingot_status.description: refinery_status of the ingot this record derives from. RIGHTS_ASSERTED is not PASSED.

source_foundry_status.description: Foundry evaluation status for the source bundle.

source_artifacts.description: Exact source artifacts used to derive the released row. Raw source bytes remain excluded; their roles and hashes remain bound.

rights_status.description: Free string, but admissibility is an allow-list in code: anything not explicitly admissible blocks release. UNKNOWN is the default and is never admissible.

rights_assertion.description: Assertion bodies are private verification inputs and must not appear on a v3 distributable row.

rights_assertion_binding.description: Hash-only binding to a private rights assertion. The body is supplied only during full-provenance verification.

privacy_receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the final-row privacy receipt bytes.

privacy_receipt_ref.description: Pack-relative or content-addressed locator for the final-row privacy receipt.

privacy_ruleset_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact privacy ruleset used for the final-row decision.

quality_review.description: Must name automated and manual treatment distinctly. Never reuse a value implying a human read the record when none did.

split_group_id.description: Primary leakage key, retained for v1 consumers. It must also occur in split_group_ids.

split_group_ids.description: All conservative leakage keys for the row, such as session, conversation, source artifact and derivation-family keys. The primary split_group_id must be included; code enforces this cross-field invariant.
